# Setup

## Reset working directory to the project root

<!--
This script lives in R/analysis/ (see the project skeleton), but Quarto
executes chunks with the working directory set to the .qmd's own folder by
default -- so project-relative paths like "data/derived" would otherwise
resolve against R/analysis/, not the project root. This must be its own
chunk: root.dir only takes effect starting with the chunk after it's set,
so a dir.create() call in the same chunk as this line would still run
against the old (wrong) directory.
-->

```{r}
#| label: root-dir

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "../..")
```

## Load libraries and set default options

```{r}
#| label: setup

# Core packages for this analysis -- data.table for tabular work, RForInvt
# for versioning/utility helpers, ggplot2 for figures, sf/terra for spatial.
library(data.table)
library(RForInvt)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(terra)

# Standard chunk defaults for this document.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
    echo      = TRUE
  , warning   = FALSE
  , message   = FALSE
  , fig.width  = 7
  , fig.height = 5
  )

options(scipen = 10E6)

# Directories used throughout -- adjust to the project's actual layout.
dir_derived = "data/derived"
dir_out     = "output/figures"
dir.create(dir_derived, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(dir_out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Data

## Load or rebuild the primary dataset

<!--
Only rebuilds if a source file's size/date changed, or build_version below
was bumped by hand to signal a real logic change. See
r_coding_standards.md Section 12 for the plain-language explanation of why
this is mtime/size + a manual version tag rather than a full code hash.
-->

```{r}
#| label: load-primary-data

#1. define paths to the cache and its "fingerprint" sidecar
cache_rds     = file.path(dir_derived, "dat_primary.rds")
cache_key_rds = file.path(dir_derived, "dat_primary.key.rds")

#2. list source files this dataset is built from
#  - any file added here triggers a rebuild if its size or mtime changes
source_files = c("data/raw/plots.csv", "data/raw/trees.csv")

#3. set the manual build-version tag
#  - bump this by hand only when the loading/creation logic below
#    meaningfully changes, not for cosmetic edits like a comment tweak
build_version = "v1"

#4. compute the current fingerprint (source file size/mtime + version tag)
current_key = list(
    sources = file.info(source_files)[, c("size", "mtime")]
  , version = build_version
  )

#5. decide whether a rebuild is needed
#  - stale if the cache/key files are missing, or the fingerprint changed
needs_rebuild = !file.exists(cache_rds) || !file.exists(cache_key_rds) ||
  !identical(current_key, readRDS(cache_key_rds))

#6. rebuild if stale, otherwise reload the cached result
if (needs_rebuild) {
  # Actual data creation/loading logic goes here.
  dat = data.table::fread(source_files[1])

  # Save the rebuilt data and its fingerprint for the next run.
  saveRDS(dat, cache_rds)
  saveRDS(current_key, cache_key_rds)
} else {
  # Nothing changed -- reload the previously saved result.
  dat = readRDS(cache_rds)
}
```
